verbalization: Ent-Gloeosteretriol is implicated in a complex network of interactions that ultimately lead to the targeting of Atypical kinase COQ8A, mitochondrial. The evidence suggests that Ent-Gloeosteretriol acts as a target for DMS-53, which in turn is a target of Gerontoisoflavone A. Gerontoisoflavone A is known to inhibit Atypical kinase COQ8A, mitochondrial, indicating a direct pathway through which Ent-Gloeosteretriol may influence this kinase. Additionally, Ent-Gloeosteretriol is shown to target Solute carrier organic anion transporter family member 2A1, which is a target of a complex compound that also targets Atypical kinase COQ8A, mitochondrial. This suggests that Ent-Gloeosteretriol may exert its effects through a series of molecular interactions that ultimately modulate the activity of COQ8A, mitochondrial. The integrated evidence supports a mechanistic link between Ent-Gloeosteretriol and Atypical kinase COQ8A, mitochondrial, though the exact nature of the interaction remains to be fully elucidated.
